2609.08899.title: From Scores to Evidence: Auditable Decisions Can Improve Speech Deepfake Detection
2609.08899.paper_summary: Speech deepfakes can mimic a speaker's voice convincingly enough to deceive listeners and automated systems. This has driven strong progress in speech deepfake detection, but most detectors still end with one score per utterance. That score is useful for ranking systems, yet it says little about why a borderline item should be trusted, deferred, or reviewed. Two utterances can fall in the same score band for different reasons, for example because passive and retrieval evidence disagree or because the keyed probe is unavailable. We ask whether the final decision can remain scalar without discarding that provenance. We answer this question with an auditable decision record that carries four aligned cues into a late calibration step: a passive detector score, a conditional keyed-probe score on a marked derivative, retrieval support, and a speaker-profile margin, together with explicit disagreement coordinates. On the 4,080-example ASVspoof 5 Track 1 matched subset, the fixed retrieval-augmented rule improves on retrieval-only evidence, from 15.84 percent to 11.91 percent EER, and late calibration over the full record reaches 8.43 percent EER. At a 33.75 percent review budget, the exposed cue union covers 82.85 percent of the calibrated model's errors. The best passive WavLM run still reaches 6.71 percent EER, so we do not present the decision record as a stronger standalone detector. Its contribution is to preserve the evidence behind each surfaced utterance while still producing one operating score for thresholding and review.
2609.08899.paper_summary_zh: 語音深偽技術可以足夠逼真地模仿說話者的聲音，以誤導聽眾和自動系統。這推動了語音深偽檢測的強勁進展，但大多數檢測器仍然只對每次發言給出一個分數。這個分數對於排名系統是有用的，但對於為什麼一個邊緣項目應該被信任、延遲或審查卻說明不多。兩次發言可能因不同原因落在同一分數範圍內，例如因為被動和檢索證據不一致，或者因為關鍵探針不可用。我們詢問最終決策是否可以保持標量而不丟棄這些來源。我們用一個可審計的決策記錄來回答這個問題，該記錄在晚期校準步驟中攜帶四個對齊的線索：被動檢測器分數、標記衍生物上的條件關鍵探針分數、檢索支持和說話者檔案邊際，還有明確的分歧坐標。在4,080個範例的ASVspoof 5 Track 1匹配子集上，固定的檢索增強規則在僅檢索證據的基礎上從15.84%改善到11.91% EER，而對整個記錄的晚期校準達到8.43% EER。在33.75%的審查預算下，暴露的線索聯合涵蓋了校準模型錯誤的82.85%。最佳的被動WavLM運行仍達到6.71% EER，因此我們不將決策記錄呈現為一個更強的獨立檢測器。它的貢獻在於保留每個顯示出來的發言背後的證據，同時仍然為閾值設定和審查生成一個操作分數。
